podcast.body: Featured on her first album, The Lion and the Cobra, this song resonated particularly with her new female fanbase. At the time of its release, it was considered the angriest and most honest breakup song many had ever heard, and it remains an intensely powerful track. "It was, to that point, the angriest and most honest breakup song that any of us had ever heard."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Written by Sinead O'Connor when she was 18, recorded at 19, and released at 20 on her debut album *The Lion and the Cobra*. The song was inspired by her mother and an affair with a minister. While it didn't perform well as a single, it became a beloved track for fans of the album. "It was inspired by both her mother and the affair with the minister. It's called Troy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
